mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals severe labor market deterioration, prompting imminent central bank rate cuts that drive positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in job growth (PAYEMS < 130,000) and elevated unemployment (UNRATE > 7.5%) indicates accelerating labor market weakness, triggering positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days via expected policy easing.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS < 130,000 and UNRATE > 7.5% fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases (p-value > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) increase equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days as valuations contract under higher policy rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5 (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 700,000 units signal robust consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as the market anticipates sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 700 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in housing starts (HOUST > 700) and retail sales (RSAFS > 400,000) indicates broad-based economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days via sustained growth expectations.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 700 and RSAFS > 400000 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases (p-value > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 95.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, signaling economic weakness that triggers positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days via anticipated policy stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 95 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production above 95.0 signals robust manufacturing output, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days as the market prices in economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 95 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).
